issues: No attempt to get around the measurement: no file or network access, no pasted coordinates. The diff only changes the time budget and SLSQP settings and adds a second pass for promising starts.
The new check uses `bs`, which is defined outside the visible part of the diff. The run finished, so it exists.
The second pass uses res.x without checking that the optimiser succeeded. This is safe only if finalize() always makes the packing valid.
The multistart loop is timed by time.time(), so results can't be repeated exactly even with a seed. This was already true of the incumbent.
Candidate -2.636 against incumbent -2.6360, both from a single run: no detectable difference, and z can't be estimated without a measure of spread. Reject is consistent.
A sum of 2.636 is the known best result (about 2.6358) after rounding, not a new record.
